name: Ferox Ninja Park
why: Trampolines, a ninja gym and a parkour course on the Williamsburg/Greenpoint line, open to walk-ins, and absent from OpenStreetMap under any spelling -- a search for `ninja` across north Brooklyn returns nothing at all. The point is its own place record rather than an address lookup; the NTA polygon then files it under Greenpoint, which is where the boundary puts it whatever the neighbourhood is called locally.

name: Brooklyn Ninja Academy
why: The city's dedicated American-Ninja-Warrior-style obstacle gym, open to adults, and not in OpenStreetMap at all -- no node, no way, under any spelling. It is exactly the shape of thing this section exists to answer with, and the map simply has a hole where it is. Delete this entry the day somebody adds it upstream.
